title: Superpower hero
description: A full-window photo or video hero: edge to edge on phones, inset 8px with 12px corners under the header on desktop. A dark fade rises from the bottom, where a short rating line, a two-line regular-weight headline, a lead, a vermillion and a frosted pill button and a row of small facts sit at the left. Everything fades and rises in on load, one after another.
notes: forces the dark class on itself so its text stays light over the media in any theme
height follows the window: 100svh on phones, 100svh minus the 82px header on desktop
the original's hero was hidden behind a popup in every capture: its layout is inferred
